subject: ClearPath concurrency dress rehearsal & runbook - next steps
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Alex Wu <alex.wu@clearpath.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 4 Nov 2027 15:02:00 -0800
Subject: ClearPath concurrency dress rehearsal & runbook - next steps

Alex — thanks again for the demo earlier. Quick recap and suggested next steps so we can validate SLOs on your side with a customer-led rehearsal.

Recap (short):
- Target SLOs you called out: 95th pctl latency <= 150ms for non-streaming generation at 512 tokens, streaming chunk latency <= 200ms with steady 100 concurrent streams.
- Expected peak concurrency for your workload: 200-300 concurrent streaming sessions during peak events (you mentioned 250 as a reasonable target).
- Ideal throughput: ~1.2M tokens/hour during the test window for the scenarios we discussed.

What I attached: redwood_load_runbook_v2.pdf — contains runbook steps, k6/Locust pointers, recommended traffic profiles, token accounting, and a short checklist for preflight.

Immediate asks / action items for your team:
1) Share the IP allowlist for your test runners (we need the egress IPs so infra can add to the firewall).
2) Send the k6 script or locustfile you plan to run (if you want us to sanity-check it — we can run it in a staging account).
3) Confirm a 3-hour window in the next 7 calendar days for the rehearsal (we recommend a weekday morning PST to catch tail behavior).

Operational notes:
- We can provision a temporary test account scoped to your runs and provide short-lived API creds.
- If you prefer, we can stand up a dedicated pool for the rehearsal to ensure isolation; that requires a 24-hour heads-up.

Proposed windows (PST):
- Tue Nov 9, 09:00-12:00
- Wed Nov 10, 08:00-11:00

Please reply with the allowlist and preferred window. Connor and Marissa are on the thread to coordinate contract/SLAs if we need a temporary dedicated reservation.

Thanks,
Ben
Ben Carter
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com
attachments: redwood_load_runbook_v2.pdf (PDF, 48KB)
From: Alex Wu <alex.wu@clearpath.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Jordan Patel <jordan.patel@clearpath.ai>
Date: Fri, 5 Nov 2027 09:18:00 -0800
Subject: Re: ClearPath concurrency dress rehearsal & runbook - next steps

Ben — thanks for the clear recap and the runbook. This is exactly the level of detail we needed. A few quick notes from our side:

1) We are aiming for Wednesday Nov 10, 08:00-11:00 PST. That aligns with our on-call schedule.
2) I attached the k6 JSON we plan to use (clearpath_k6_config.json). It has two scenarios: conversation-generation (streaming) and summarization (non-streaming).
3) IPs for our test runners (these are static egress addresses from our CI pool):
   - 34.82.197.11
   - 34.82.197.12
   - 35.190.45.9

4) We can start at 50 concurrent streams and ramp to 250 over 25 minutes, then hold for 60 minutes, then ramp down.

5) Procurement question: will temporary test accounts require an MSA amendment or can we get a short lab addendum? procurement@clearpath.ai is on copy — Jordan, can you chime in on the procurement ask?

We also asked our infra team to share a lightweight execution plan; they can provide more details if Redwood wants to pre-validate the script.

Appreciate the help — looking forward to the rehearse.

Alex
Alex Wu
Head of Platform, ClearPath AI
alex.wu@clearpath.ai
attachments: clearpath_k6_config.json (JSON, 12KB)

Date: Fri, 5 Nov 2027 11:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: ClearPath concurrency dress rehearsal & runbook - next steps

Perfect — Wed Nov 10, 08:00-11:00 PST is booked on our side. Two operational notes before we run:

1) IP allowlist: thanks for the three addresses. Ethan, can infra get those added to the test VPC and confirm access to the staging endpoint by EOD Monday?

2) k6 script review: we will do a quick sanity pass on the clearpath_k6_config.json tonight. If anything looks off for streaming (we often recommend the chunk-level assertions be in a separate scenario) we will flag edits.

3) Temporary credentials: we will issue a scoped API key limited to test window + one hour buffer. That key will be rotated automatically after expiry. I attached a placeholder creds file in the follow-up from Ethan.

4) Dedicated pool: Marissa, I'll defer to you on whether we need the dedicated reservation given the 250 concurrent target. If ClearPath wants the extra isolation and we need to guarantee SLA targets for the rehearsal, we should provision it (24h notice).

Action items:
- Ethan to confirm IP allowlist applied and upload redwood_temp_test_creds.txt
- Ben to confirm the quick script review comments by tonight
- Marissa to confirm whether we allocate a dedicated pool and send pricing/commit options

Ben
From: Ethan Park <ethan.park@redwood.com>

On Fri, Nov 5, 2027 at 11:05 AM Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com> wrote:
> 1) IP allowlist: thanks for the three addresses. Ethan, can infra get those added to the test VPC and confirm access to the staging endpoint by EOD Monday?

All three IPs have been added to the test VPC firewall and NAT whitelist. Staging endpoint is: https://staging.api.redwood.com/clearpath-rehearsal

I've provisioned a short-lived API key and uploaded the credentials to the secure share. Attached: redwood_temp_test_creds.txt (expires Wed Nov 10 12:00 PST).

Quick infra notes for your k6 scenarios:
- For streaming scenarios we prefer using a websocket proxied endpoint with small chunk sizes (256 bytes) to replicate chunked generation. k6 websocket plugin is fine for our validation.
- We allocate a KV cache warmup phase 10 minutes prior to the hold window to avoid cold-cache spikes in latency. Please add the warmup scenario at t=-10m in your script.
- If you want us to enable dedicated pool, flag with "DEDICATED=true" in the subject of your confirmation email and we'll spin up a 2-GPU reserved pool.

Attachment: redwood_temp_test_creds.txt (TXT, 1KB) — contains:
- api_key: redwood-test-ck_eyJz... (scoped to rehearsal)
- endpoint: https://staging.api.redwood.com/clearpath-rehearsal
- expires: 2027-11-10T12:00:00-08:00

Let us know if you want us to perform a dry-run at 50 concurrent streams the day before.

Thanks,
Ethan Park
Platform Reliability Engineer, Redwood Inference
ethan.park@redwood.com

Thanks team — procurement can accept a lab addendum for temporary test accounts, no MSA amendment required. I confirmed the window and the infra team will be on call.

We will:
- Run the k6 profile as attached; ramp to 250 concurrent streams over 25 minutes, hold for 60 minutes.
- Include the 10-minute KV warmup.
- Start with a dry-run at 50 concurrent streams on Tue Nov 9, 16:00 PST to validate connectivity.

See you Wednesday morning. If you need to flip on dedicated pool we will give you notice by EOD today.
